pr_title: net: context: Fix the ICMP error on udp
pr_body:
This commit fixes the ##70020.

When receiving a UDP packet, net_conn_input() searches for a matching connection within `conn_used`.

However, when receiving UDP packets simultaneously from multiple clients, we may encounter a situation where the connection that was supposed to be bound cannot be found within `conn_used`, and raise the ICMP error.

This is because, within recv_udp(), to avoid the failure of bind_default(), we temporarily remove it from `conn_used` using net_conn_unregister().

If the context already has a connection handler, it means it's already registered. In that case, all we have to do is 1) update the callback registered in the net_context and 2) update the user_data using net_conn_change_callback().

Since net_conn_change_callback() takes the _other_ callback function, net_context_packet_received() (I know it's confusing), this must be the same function passed in net_conn_register() down below.

-----

Fixes #70020

issue_context.title: net: ICMP error occurs when accessing simultaneously over UDP
issue_context.body: **Describe the bug** We are implementing a CoAP Server using the zephyr's CoAP library. When executing a test program that continuously sends CoAP GET requests to this CoAP server from two CoAP clients, the following error may be detected: ` Mar 10 10:36:31.436 WARN ** 10.30.5.20:50338 <-> 10.30.5.10:5683 UDP : coap_socket_recv: ICMP: Connection refused` - What target platform are you using? - Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA (Soft core: ARM Cortex-M3) - What have you tried to diagnose or workaround this issue? - After receiving an ICMP error on the CoAP client side, we are trying to retries. - Is this a regression? If yes, have you been able to "git bisect" it to a specific commit? - No **To Reproduce** Since our platform is not a generic platform, we will provide replication steps using STM32 F429 board. 1. add extra conf (extra.conf) ``` CONFIG_NET_IPV6=n CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_NEED_IPV6=n CONFIG_NET_IPV4=y CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_NEED_IPV4=y CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_MY_IPV4_ADDR="10.30.5.10" CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_MY_IPV4_NETMASK="255.255.0.0" CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_MY_IPV4_GW="10.30.5.1" ``` 2. To induce ICMP errors, as they are timing-dependent, we are applying the following patch to ensure that the issue occurs promptly. ``` diff --git a/subsys/net/ip/net_context.c b/subsys/net/ip/net_context.c index ae7a4a4e84..19418ad358 100644 --- a/subsys/net/ip/net_context.c +++ b/subsys/net/ip/net_context.c @@ -2411,6 +2411,8 @@ static int recv_udp(struct net_context *context, return ret; } + k_sleep(K_MSEC(1)); + if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_NET_IPV6) && net_context_get_family(context) == AF_INET6) { if (net_sin6_ptr(&context->local)->sin6_addr) { ``` 3. build ``` rm -rf build & west build -b nucleo_f429zi zephyr/samples/net/sockets/coap_server -- -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=${PWD}/right-upper.conf ``` 4. flash ``` west flash ``` 5. confirm to ready fo coap server ``` *** Booting Zephyr OS build v3.6.0-674-g826ac0755b41 *** [00:00:00.011,000] net_config: Initializing network [00:00:00.011,000] net_config: Waiting interface 1 (0x20000ea8) to be up... [00:00:02.011,000] net_config: Interface 1 (0x20000ea8) coming up [00:00:02.011,000] net_config: IPv4 address: 10.30.5.10 [00:00:02.013,000] net_coap_service_sample: CoAP service coap_server started uart:~$ ``` 6. Execute the following script on two console ``` while true do coap-client -m get coap://10.30.5.10/test done ``` 7. ICMP error occurs ``` Mar 10 19:22:55.714 WARN ** 10.30.5.20:46563 <-> 10.30.5.10:5683 UDP : coap_socket_recv: ICMP: Connection refused ``` **Expected behavior** No ICMP errors occurs **Impact** annoyance **Logs and console output** We captured packets using `wireshark` when this error occurred, and the following error message was replied from the CoAP Server side: ![coap-icmp-error](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/93954843/2402334d-2879-4b64-8bb3-71399666322f) Detail of ICMP error packet: (`Dst port: 5683` is default port number of CoAP Server) **Environment (please complete the following information):** - OS: - 22.04.4 LTS (Build OS) - Toolchain (e.g Zephyr SDK, ...) - zephyr-sdk-0.16.3 - Commit SHA - 826ac07
